explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/391: with t(n) the maximal t such that n! = a₁⋯a_n with every a_i ≥ t, is lim t(n)/n = 1/e? Yes (Alexeev–Conway–Rosenfeld–Sutherland–Tao–Uhr–Ventullo). t is the sSup of k with such a factorisation (an ordering is irrelevant). The statement asserts t(n)/n → 1/e. Faithful.
